αἰγυπτίων: Αἰγύπτιος — Egyptian; masc. gen. pl. (Αἰγυπτίων ἀνδρῶν ’of Egyptian men’)
αἰγύπτῳ: Αἴγυπτος — Egypt; fem. dat. sg., poetic dat. of direction: ‘to Egypt’ · also a plain dative of place where, ’in Egypt’ (Αἰγύπτῳ ... ἔσχον ’the gods held me back in Egypt’) · also Αἴγυπτος, masc., the river Nile; dat. sg., with ποταμῷ in apposition: ’in the river Egypt’
αἴγυπτον: Αἴγυπτος — Egypt, also the river Nile (masc., as river); acc. sg., with ἐϋρρείτην ’fair-flowing’: ’the Egypt river’, goal of ἱκόμεσθα
αἴγυπτόνδ: Αἴγυπτος — Egypt; acc. sg. + -δε suffix of direction, elided (Αἴγυπτόνδ’ = Αἴγυπτόνδε): ’to Egypt’
αἴθ: αἴθε — would that; epic wish particle + opt., elided (αἴθ’ = αἴθε; = εἰ γάρ, αἲ γάρ)
αὐτούς: αὐτός — self; masc. acc. pl.: ’them’ · also intensive, ’the very men themselves’ (with a following τε … τε) · also ’ourselves’, first person, coordinate with another object (νῆάς τε καὶ αὐτούς ’both the ships and ourselves’) · also third person, coordinate with another object: ’and themselves’ (δῶ … αὐτούς τ’ ’the house … and themselves’)
αὐτοῦ: αὐτός — self; masc. gen. sg., intensive with a possessive (ἑὸν αὐτοῦ ’his own very own’): ’of himself’ · also the fixed adv. αὐτοῦ, ’there, on the spot, right here’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun, unemphatic ’him’, governed by a preposition: ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ ’from him’ · also intensive with a noun, masc. gen. sg.: ’Alcinous himself’ (αὐτοῦ Ἀλκινόοιο) · also reflexive intensive gen. sg. after a personal pronoun: σέο τ’ αὐτοῦ ’and of yourself’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun of a thing, ’from it’, after ἐκ (ἐκ δ’ αὐτοῦ πείρατ’ ἀνήφθω, of the mast) · also masc. gen. sg., intensive with a possessive sense, ’his own’: αὐτοῦ ἐνεύναιον ’his own bedding’, αὐτοῦ βώτορες ’his own herdsmen’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun with a noun, ’his’: ὀστέα δ’ αὐτοῦ ’and his bones’ · also intensive gen. sg. with a demonstrative and noun: τοῦδ’ αὐτοῦ λυκάβαντος ’this very year’
αὐτόν: αὐτός — self; masc. acc. sg.: ’himself’, or reinforcing a pronoun of any person (με … καὶ αὐτόν ’me myself as well’) · also plain acc. sg. pronoun, unemphatic ’him’ as direct object of a verb: ἤλασε δ’ αὐτόν ’struck him’ · also plain acc. sg. pronoun, unemphatic ’him’, as subject of an infinitive: αὐτόν τε ζώειν ’that he live’
αὐτὰρ: αὐτάρ — but, and then; epic conj. (= Attic δέ, ἀλλά)
αὖτ: αὖτε (elided αὖτ’) — again, in turn, moreover; epic adv./conj.
αὖτε: αὖτε — again, in turn, on the other hand; adv.
αὖτις: αὖτις — back, again, once more; adv. (= αὖθις)
βάζεις: βάζω — chatter, babble, talk; pres. 2 sg.
βάλε: βάλλω — throw, cast; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔβαλε): ’cast’
βάλεν: βάλλω — throw, cast; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, in tmesis with ἀμφί: ’threw about’ · also in tmesis with ἐπί (βάλεν δ’ ἐπὶ ... ἑκάστῳ = ἐπέβαλε): ’threw over, cast upon’ · also in tmesis with παρά (πάρ … βάλεν = παρέβαλε): ’threw beside, set before’ · also without tmesis, with κε, unreal past: ’would have hurled’ (κε … βάλεν … ποτὶ πέτρας ’would have dashed her against the rocks’) · also in tmesis with ἐν (ἐν … βάλεν = ἐνέβαλε): ’cast into, sent upon’ (φύζαν … βάλεν ’sent panic upon’)
βάλοι: βάλλω — throw, cast, let fall; aor. opt. 3 sg.: ’would let fall’ (κατὰ δάκρυ βάλοι ’would shed a tear’)
βέλος: βέλος — missile, thing thrown; neut. acc. sg. (here a hurled rock)
βασιλῆϊ: βασιλεύς — king; masc. dat. sg., epic -ῆϊ (= Attic βασιλεῖ)
βοῆς: βοή — shout, cry; fem. gen. sg., gen. of what is heard (with ἀίοντες): ’hearing the cry’
βυσσοδομεύων: βυσσοδομεύω — plan deep in the heart, brood on; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
γ: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle (elided γ’)
γάμοιο: γάμος — marriage, wedding; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
γένοιτο: γίγνομαι — become, happen, turn out; aor. opt. 3 sg. (ὅπως ἄριστα γένοιτο ’how it might turn out best’) · also aor. opt. 3 sg. in a wish with μή: μὴ ... φίλον γένοιτο ’may it not prove pleasing’ · also aor. opt. 3 sg. in a wish after αἲ γάρ: αἲ γὰρ τοῦτο γένοιτο ’would that this might happen’
γε: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle
γυναιξίν: γυνή — woman; fem. dat. pl., epic -ξιν (ν-movable)
γυναῖκας: γυνή — woman, wife; fem. acc. pl.
δάκρυ: δάκρυ — tear; neut. acc. sg., used collectively: ’tears’ · also elided δάκρυ’ = δάκρυα, neut. acc. pl. · also literal sg. with an attributive adjective, not collective: θαλερὸν δάκρυ ’a swelling tear’
δή: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δίδοσαν: δίδωμι — give; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἐδίδοσαν): ’they kept giving’
δαίμων: δαίμων — a god, some divine power (vague, unspecified); masc. nom. sg.
δαιτὸς: δαίς — feast, meal; gen. sg., after κορέννυμι: ’sated with the feast’ · also gen. after δεύομαι ’lack’: ’lacking the feast’ (δαιτὸς ἐΐσης)
διὰ: διά — through, throughout; prep. + acc. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb: διὰ … τινάξῃ = διατινάξῃ ’shake apart, shatter’ · also + acc., causal, ’through, thanks to, by the aid of’ (διὰ … Ἀθήνην) · also as adverb/preverb in tmesis with κοσμηθέντες (διὰ … κοσμηθέντες = διακοσμηθέντες ’drawn up in divisions’) · also + gen., ’through, among’ (διὰ μήλων ’among the flocks’) · also prep. + gen., ’through’ (διὰ πτόλιος ’through the city’)
διὲκ: διέκ — out through, right through; prep. + gen. (διά + ἐκ, epic)
δμῳῇσι: δμῳή — female slave, handmaid; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῇσι (= Attic -αις)
δμῳῇσιν: δμῳή — serving-woman, slave-woman; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι(ν) (= Attic -αις)
δμῶες: δμώς — servant, slave (male); masc. nom. pl.
δοίης: δίδωμι — give; aor. opt. 2 sg.: ’you might give’
δοκέεις: δοκέω — seem, think; pres. 2 sg., uncontracted (= Attic δοκεῖς)
δολιχὴν: δολιχός — long; adj., fem. acc. sg., agreeing with ὁδόν: ’a long (journey)’
δόμεναι: δίδωμι — give; aor. inf., epic -μεναι, used as imperative: ’give’ · also inf. after ὀτρύνω, ’to give’ (πομπὴν ὀτρύνω δόμεναι ’I urge (him) to give a conveyance’) · also inf. complementing an impersonal ’it seemed better’: ’to give’ (κέρδιον εἶναι … δόμεναι ’better to give’)
δόσαν: δίδωμι — give; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented, epic (= Attic ἔδοσαν)
δύστηνον: δύστηνος — wretched, unhappy; masc. acc. sg.
δύστηνος: δύστηνος — wretched; adj., masc. nom. sg.
δώματ: δῶμα — house, home; neut. acc. pl., elided (δώματ’ = δώματα) · also neut. nom. pl., subject: κλυτὰ δώματ’ ἔασιν ’his famous halls are’
δὴ: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δῖον: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; masc. acc. sg., epithet of heroes
δῖος: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; masc. nom. sg., epithet of heroes (= fem. δῖα)
δῶμα: δῶμα — house, hall, dwelling; acc. sg. · also nom. sg. (identical neut. form), subject of a verb: ’the house’
εἰ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. · also introducing an indirect question after a verb of asking or telling: ’whether’ (εἰ δή ’whether indeed’) · also in εἰ δ’ ἄγε, an interjectional idiom with the imperative: ’come now, well then’ · also with opt., in a wish: ’if only’ (εἰ … ὁμοφρονέοις … γένοιο) · also ὡς εἰ + opt., ’as if’ (ὡς εἰ … ἱκοίατο ’as if they had come’)
εἰσίν: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 pl.: ’they are’ (Attic form, alongside the epic by-form ἔασιν)
εἴ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. (accented εἴ before a following enclitic, περ among them) · also introducing an indirect question, ‘whether’ (τίς δ’ οἶδ’ εἴ κέ ... ‘who knows whether’) · also with opt., of an aim in view: ’in case, to see if’ (εἴ τινά … λάβοι ’in case he might catch someone’) · also in ὡς εἴ τ’ + opt., ’as if’ · also in ὡς εἴ τε with no verb or optative expressed: ’as if’
εἴξαντες: εἴκω — yield, give way to (+ dat.); aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’giving in to’
εἴπεσκε: εἶπον (aor. of λέγω/φημί) — say, speak; iterative impf. 3 sg. with suffix -σκε, epic (= ἔλεγεν ἄν): ’would say, used to say’
εἴπω: εἶπον — say, tell; aor. subj. 1 sg.
εἵνεκα: ἕνεκα — because of, for the sake of; prep. + gen., epic prothetic ε- (εἵνεκα)
εὐπείθεος: Εὐπείθης — Eupeithes, father of Antinous; masc. gen. sg.
ζεὺς: Ζεύς — Zeus, king of the gods; nom. sg.
ζωούς: ζωός — alive, living; masc. acc. pl., epic/Ionic (= Attic ζῶντας): ’alive’, predicative
θανάτοιο: θάνατος — death; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
θαρσαλέος: θαρσαλέος — bold, confident; masc. nom. sg.
θεοὶ: θεός — god; nom. pl. · also voc. pl. (same form): ’you gods!’
θεός: θεός — god; masc. nom. sg. · also fem. nom. sg. ’goddess’ (δεινὴ θεός; θεός is common gender)
θυμὸς: θυμός — heart, spirit, desire; nom. sg.
θῆκεν: τίθημι — put, place; aor. 3 sg. · also ’make (someone a certain way)’, with double acc.: ’made him (taller)’
κάκ: κακός — bad, evil; neut. acc. pl. (elided κάκ’): ’evils, misfortunes’ · also neut. nom. pl., elided (κάκ’ = κακά), agreeing with ἀράχνια: ’foul (cobwebs)’
κάκιστος: κακός — bad; superlative κάκιστος, masc. nom. sg.: ’worst’
κάλ: καλός — fair, beautiful, goodly; adj., neut. acc. pl., elided (κάλ’ = καλά), agreeing with ἱερά
κάρη: κάρη — head; neut. acc. sg., acc. of respect: ’as to the head’ · also plain acc. sg., direct object of a verb: κινήσας κάρη ’shaking his head’
κέ: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); accented before an enclitic · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’so that’ (ὄφρα κέ τοι λύσῃ ’so that she may free’) · also + subj. in the protasis after αἴ: ’if perhaps’ (αἴ κέ ποθι Ζεὺς δώῃ ’if Zeus should somehow grant’) · also + subj. in the protasis after εἴ: ’if perhaps’ (εἴ κέ τιν’ … εὕρωμεν ’if we should find any’) · also + opt. in the protasis after αἴ: ’if perhaps’ (αἴ κέ μοι … παρασταίης ’if you would stand by me’) · also + aor. indic., unreal past: τῷ κέ με … ὤνησεν ’would have benefited me’ · also + fut./short-vowel aor. subj. in a main clause: κέ τοι καταλέξω ’I shall tell you’ · also + opt. in the protasis after εἴ: ’if perhaps’ (εἴ κέ μιν ἀγγείλαιμι ’if I might report him’) · also + subj. after εἰς ὅ, ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κέ τοι φήνωσι ’until they show you’) · also + subj. in a prospective relative clause: ’who shall’ (ὅς κέ με κεῖσ’ ἀγάγῃ ’who shall lead me there’) · also + fut. indic. (or short-vowel subj.) in a clause after εἴ: ’whether perhaps’ (εἴ κέ σφι … τελευτήσει ’whether … it will come to pass for them’) · also + opt., potential, in a main clause: ’might’ (καί κέ τεο … πειρηθεῖμεν ’we might test any of’)
κέκλυτέ: κλύω — hear, listen to; reduplicated aor. imper. 2 pl., + gen.: ’hear (me)’
καθήμενος: κάθημαι — sit; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’sitting’
κακὰ: κακός — bad, evil; neut. acc. pl. · also neut. nom. pl., subject: κακὰ ἔργα ’bad deeds’
κακὴν: κακός — bad, evil; fem. acc. sg. (ἔριν ... κακήν ’evil strife’)
καλέονται: καλέω — call, name; pres. 3 pl. pass., epic uncontracted (= Attic καλοῦνται)
καλέσασα: καλέω — call; aor. part. fem. nom. sg.
καλὰ: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; neut. acc. pl.
κατ: κατά (elided κατ’) — down from, throughout; + gen./acc. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (κατ’ … ἕζετο = κατέζετο ’sat down’)
κατὰ: κατά — down, throughout, in; prep. + acc.; also as preverb in tmesis (κατὰ … ἤσθιον = κατήσθιον ’devoured’) · also ’according to, in conformity with’ (κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’) · also + acc., ’in quest of, after’ (κατὰ ληίδα ’in quest of plunder’) · also + gen., ’down from’ (κατὰ πετράων ’down from the rocks’) · also + gen., ’all over, throughout’ (κατὰ σπείους κέχυτο ’lay spread all over the cave’) · also + acc., of the part grasped: ’by’ (κατὰ νῶτα λαβών ’taking him by the back’) · also + acc., ’on account of, on the business of’ (κατὰ χρέος ’on business’) · also + gen., ’down in, within’ (κατὰ σπείους κοίλοιο δέδυκεν ’is sunk in the hollow cave’)
κείμενον: κεῖμαι — lie, be laid; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ‘lying’
κελεύει: κελεύω — bid, urge, order; pres. 3 sg.
κελόμην: κέλομαι — urge, bid, command; impf. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἐκελόμην): ’I urged’
κεχρημένος: χράομαι — use; perf. part. (+ gen.) ’in need of, lacking’; masc. nom. sg.
κηρόθι: κῆρ — heart; with the suffix -θι of place: ’in the heart’, adv.
κηρὶ: κήρ — death, doom allotted to a person; fem. dat. sg.
κρειῶν: κρέας — meat, flesh; neut. gen. pl., epic κρειῶν with ει for ε (= Attic κρεῶν)
κρονίων: Κρονίων — son of Cronus, Zeus; masc. nom. sg., by-form of Κρονίδης
κὰδ: κατά (apocope κάδ before δ-) — down through, throughout; prep./preverb in tmesis: ’throughout the halls’ (κὰδ δώματα = κατὰ δώματα) · also a bare preverb in tmesis with a verb: κὰδ ... ἔβαλε = κατέβαλε ’threw down’
λυγρῆς: λυγρός — bitter, baneful; fem. gen. sg.
μ: ἐγώ — I; encl. acc. sg., elided (μ’ = με): ’me’ · also = dat. μοι, elided before a vowel, with a dat. participle: ’to me’ (ἥ μ’ οἴῳ ἔρροντι συνήντετο, συναντάω + dat.)
μάλ: μάλα (elided μάλ’) — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.
μάλα: μάλα — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.
μάλιστα: μάλα — very, much; superl. adv. μάλιστα: ’most of all, especially’
μέγα: μέγας — great, huge; neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’greatly’ (μέγα νήπιοι ’greatly foolish’)
μέν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ (the acute μέν is kept before a following enclitic; elsewhere μὲν) · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’ (οὐ μέν ’not indeed’) · also μένω — stay, wait; pres. imper. 2 sg., elided (μέν’ = μένε): ’stay’
μένειν: μένω — stay, remain, wait; pres. inf. act.
μένεϊ: μένος — might, force, fury; neut. dat. sg., epic -εϊ (= Attic -ει), object of ἐπισπόμενοι (‘following’): ‘their own might’
μέσσον: μέσος — middle, in the middle; neut. acc. sg., epic -σσ- (= Attic μέσον), used as a noun: ’the middle’ · also adverbial neut. acc. sg.: ’midway’ (μέσσον ὑπὲρ Κρήτης ’midway over Crete’)
μή: μή — not; negative particle (used with imperatives and subjunctives, unlike οὐ) · also introducing a negative purpose/fear clause with the optative in secondary sequence: μή ἑ λάθοι ’lest he should escape notice’ · also μή + fut. inf. after a verb of swearing/promising, negating its content: μή ... βουλευσέμεν ’that ... will not plan’ · also ’lest’ with the subj. after a primary verb (μή πώς ... χαλεπήνῃ ’lest he be harsh’) · also in a question expecting the answer ’no’, after ἦ: ἦ μή … φάσθ’ ἔμμεναι; ’surely you do not say … are?’ · also ’lest’ + subj. after a past verb of urging (κελόμην … μή … λάθηται ’I urged … lest he forget’) · also in a condition, ’if … not’ (εἰ … μή τίς σε βιάζεται) · also with an infinitive used as an imperative, a prohibition: μή μ’ … καταλείπειν ’do not leave me’ · also negating a purpose clause after ἵνα: ’so that … not’ (ἵνα μή τι … ἀλγήσετε ’so that you may not suffer’) · also with the optative, a negative wish: ’may … not’ (μή … ἀντιβολήσαις) · also ὡς ἂν μή + subj., negative purpose: ’so that … not’ (ὡς ἂν μή σε κατατρύχῃ ’so that he may not wear you out’)
μαψιδίως: μαψιδίως — idly, heedlessly, to no purpose; adv. · also ’without cause’, beside an infinitive of a wrongful act (μαψιδίως ψεύδεσθαι ’to lie without cause’)
μαῖ: μαῖα — nurse, mother (affectionate address to an old woman); fem. voc. sg., elided (μαῖ’ = μαῖα)
μεγάρῳ: μέγαρον — hall, great room; neut. dat. sg.
μελαίνῃ: μέλας — black; standing epithet of ships; fem. dat. sg. μέλαινα · also modifying a different noun, not a ship (μελαίνῃ φρικί ’with a dark ripple’, of the sea’s surface)
μετ: μετά (elided μετ’) — among, after, in quest of; prep. + acc. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (μετ’ … βαῖνε = μετέβαινε ’followed’) · also + dat., ’among, between’ (μετ’ ἀμφοτέροισιν ’between the two of them’) · also + gen., ’among, in company with’ (μετ’ ἄλλων … ἑταίρων ’among your other companions’)
μετὰ: μετά — among, with, after; prep. + dat./acc./gen. · with acc. also ’in quest of, in search of’ (μετὰ χαλκόν ’after bronze’) · also a plain adverb, no case governed: ’besides, in addition’ · also adverb, ’among them, in their midst’: μετὰ δὲ πρέπει ἀγρομένοισιν ’and he stands out among the gathered’ · also as preverb in tmesis (μετὰ … βεβήκει = μεταβεβήκει ’had moved on, passed on’) · also a plain adverb, ’afterwards’ (μετὰ γάρ τε καὶ ἄλγεσι τέρπεται ἀνήρ ’for afterwards a man takes pleasure even in pains’; some take it as ’among’ with ἄλγεσι) · also + dat. of the mind, ’in’ (μετὰ φρεσὶ σῇσι ’in your mind’)

μηχανόωνται: μηχανάομαι — contrive, devise, scheme; pres. 3 pl., epic uncontracted -όωνται (= Attic -ῶνται): ’they contrive’
μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)
μοι: ἐγώ — I; encl. dat. sg.: ’to me, for me’ · also dat. of the person affected, ’from my …’ (μοι βλεφάρων ἐξέσσυτο ὕπνος ’sleep rushed out from my eyelids’) · also dat. of possession with εἰμί: ’who are mine’ (οἵ μοι ἔασιν ’who are mine’)
μυρίοι: μυρίος — countless, numberless; masc. nom. pl. (later ’ten thousand’)
μύθων: μῦθος — speech, word, thing said (not yet ’myth’ in Homer); gen. pl.
μὰν: μάν — truly, indeed; epic particle (= Attic μήν); οὐ μάν ’surely not’
μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’: οὐ μὲν δή ’surely not’

μᾶλλον: μάλα — very, much; comparative adv. μᾶλλον: ’more, rather, the more’
μῦθον: μῦθος — word, speech, thing said; acc. sg. · also a plan, scheme agreed on (τοῖον...τελέωμεν μῦθον ’let us carry out this plan’)
νέας: ναῦς — ship; fem. acc. pl., epic νέας (= Attic ναῦς)
νέεσθαι: νέομαι — go, return home; pres. inf., epic uncontracted (= Attic νεῖσθαι)
νέοι: νέος — young, new; masc. nom. pl.
νέων: νέος — young; masc. gen. pl. · also a different word, νέω ’swim’: pres. part. masc. nom. sg., ’swimming’
νήεσσι: ναῦς — ship; fem. dat. pl., epic νήεσσι (= Attic ναυσί)
νήπια: νήπιος — without sense, foolish, childish; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’foolish things’ · also neut. nom. pl., attributive: ’infant, little’ (νήπια τέκνα ’infant children’)
νῆας: ναῦς — ship; fem. acc. pl., epic νῆας (= Attic ναῦς)
ξείνοισιν: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend (epic = Attic ξένος); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν
ξείνῳ: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend (epic = Attic ξένος); dat. sg.
ξεῖνε: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend (epic = Attic ξένος); voc. sg.
ξεῖνός: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend (epic = Attic ξένος); masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic

οὐδέ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj.
οὐκ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a vowel with smooth breathing (οὐχ before a rough breathing)
οὐκέτι: οὐκέτι — no longer, not any more; adv.
οὐλομένης: οὐλόμενος — accursed, destructive, ruinous (perf. part. of ὄλλυμι used as adj.); fem. gen. sg.
οὔ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ · also the plain negative adverb in a declarative statement, with no question implied: ’not’
οὔτ: οὔτε (elided οὔτ’) — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.
οὔτε: οὔτε — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.
οὕτως: οὕτω(ς) — so, thus, in this way; adv.
οὗτος: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; masc. nom. sg.

πάντες: πᾶς — all, every; masc. nom. pl.
πάντεσσι: πᾶς — all, every; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic πᾶσι)
πάντοθεν: πάντοθεν — from all sides, on every side; adv.

πάσχων: πάσχω — suffer, experience; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’suffering’
πένθος: πένθος — grief, sorrow; neut. nom./acc. sg.
πέτρη: πέτρη — rock, crag; fem. nom. sg.

πήρην: πήρη — wallet, beggar’s bag; fem. acc. sg.

πεζῶν: πεζός — on foot; used as a noun: ’foot-soldiers’; masc. gen. pl., gen. of what fills, after πλῆτο

περίφρων: περίφρων — circumspect, of sound understanding; fem. nom. sg., stock epithet of Penelope · also epithet of Arete: fem. nom. sg., ’the circumspect queen’
περικαλλέας: περικαλλής — very beautiful (περι- intensive); adj. (2-term.), masc. acc. pl., epic uncontracted -έας (= Attic -εῖς)

πηνελόπεια: Πηνελόπεια — Penelope, wife of Odysseus; nom. sg.
πλῆτο: πίμπλημι — fill; aor. mid./pass. 3 sg., unaugmented, epic (= Attic ἐπλήσθη): ’was filled’ (+ gen.)
πολλάκι: πολλάκι(ς) — many times, often; adv., epic (= Attic πολλάκις)
πολλοὺς: πολύς — much, many; masc. acc. pl.
πολλὰ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl.: ’many things, greatly’ · also neut. nom. pl., plain attributive adj. agreeing with a neut. pl. noun (πολλὰ ... δάκρυα ’many tears’) · also neut. acc. pl., plain attributive adj. πολύμητις: πολύμητις — of many wiles, epithet of Odysseus (built on μῆτις ’cunning intelligence’); masc. nom. sg.
ποτε: ποτέ — once, at some time, formerly; enclitic adv.
πού: πού — somewhere; enclitic adv., weakened to ’I suppose, perhaps’
προικὸς: προίξ — gift, dowry; gen. sg. προικός, adverbial: ’as a free gift, with no return’
προσέειπε: προσεῖπον — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic προσεῖπε)
προσέφη: πρόσφημι — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg.
προσηύδα: προσαυδάω — speak to, address; impf. 3 sg.
πρὸ: πρό — before, in front; prep. + gen.; also adv. or preverb in tmesis, ’ahead, forward’ (πρὸ … ἔαξεν ’broke ahead’)

πτερόεντα: πτερόεις — winged (πτερόν ’feather, wing’); neut. acc. pl.: ’winged (words)’
πόδας: πούς — foot; acc. pl., accusative of respect · also acc. pl., direct object: ’feet’ (πόδας καὶ χεῖρας ’feet and hands’)
πόποι: πόποι — (in ὢ πόποι) exclamation of surprise or displeasure: ’ah! well!’; origin unknown
πόρθεον: πορθέω — sack, ravage, plunder; impf. 3 pl., epic uncontracted, unaugmented (= Attic ἐπόρθουν): ’they ravaged’

πῆμα: πῆμα — woe, calamity, disaster; neut. nom. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., direct object: ’woe’

σίτου: σῖτος — bread, grain, food; masc. gen. sg.
σκοπιὰς: σκοπιή — lookout, watch-post; fem. acc. pl.
στήθεσσι: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι
στεροπῆς: στεροπή — lightning, flash, gleam; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ῆς, gen. of what fills after πλῆτο: ’the gleam (of bronze)’

τέλος: τέλος — end, completion, fulfilment; neut. nom./acc. sg.

ταμίη: ταμίη — housekeeper, stewardess, woman with charge of the stores (Attic ταμία, Ionic η for α); nom. sg.

τούτων: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this, that; gen. pl.: ’of these’

τόδ: ὅδε — this, this here; neut. nom./acc. sg., elided (τόδ’ = τόδε)
τόδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., neut. nom./acc. sg.
τὰ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’ · also in the adverbial idiom τὰ πρῶτα, ’at first, first’ (not ’these things’) · also with a noun, pointing to it: ’those, the’ (τὰ σὰ γούνατα ’those knees of yours’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: which; neut. nom. pl. φρένες: φρήν — mind, heart, midriff (seat of feeling); fem. nom. pl.
φρεσὶν: φρήν — mind, heart, wits (lit. midriff); fem. dat. pl.
φύζαν: φύζα — panic flight, rout; fem. acc. sg.
φώνησέν: φωνέω — utter, speak aloud, call out; aor. 3 sg., accented φώνησέν before the enclitic τε
χαλκοῦ: χαλκός — bronze, copper; masc. gen. sg.
χαμαὶ: χαμαί — on the ground, to the ground; adv.
χαρίσασθαι: χαρίζομαι — give as a favour, give freely; aor. inf. mid.: ’to give freely’

ἀλλοδαποῖσι: ἀλλοδαπός — of another land, foreign; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις), used substantively: ’to men of other lands’

ἀνέρας: ἀνήρ — man; masc. acc. pl., epic ἀνέρας (= Attic ἄνδρας)
ἀνίην: ἀνίη — distress, trouble; fem. acc. sg., epic -ίη (= Attic ἀνία), in apposition
ἀναιδής: ἀναιδής — shameless, ruthless, relentless; masc. nom. sg.

ἀνθρώπων: ἄνθρωπος — human being, man; gen. pl.

ἀντινόοιο: Ἀντίνοος — Antinous, a leading suitor; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)

ἀφνειοὶ: ἀφνειός — rich, wealthy; masc. nom. pl.

ἄν: ἄν — modal particle marking contingency (with subj. = future contingency, with opt. = potential)
ἄναγον: ἀνάγω — lead up, carry off; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἀνῆγον): ’they led off’
ἄνασσεν: ἀνάσσω — be lord of, rule over (+ dat.); impf. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’was lord over’

ἄρα: ἄρα — so, as it turned out, then; inferential particle
ἄχος: ἄχος — grief, pain, distress; neut. nom. sg.

ἐμοῖς: ἐμός — my, mine; masc. dat. pl.
ἐμπάζετο: ἐμπάζομαι — pay heed to, care for (+ gen.); impf. 3 sg. mid.: ’was heeding’
ἐμῆς: ἐμός — my, mine; fem. gen. sg.
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐναντίβιον: ἐναντίβιος — face to face, in open opposition; neut. acc. sg. used as an adverb: ’to meet them face to face’

ἐπισπόμενοι: ἕπομαι — follow; aor. part. masc. nom. pl.: ‘following’

ἐρίηρας: ἐρίηρος — traditionally ’trusty’, exact sense uncertain (of companions); masc. acc. pl.
ἐργάζεσθαι: ἐργάζομαι — work, labour; pres. inf. mid., of purpose: ’to work (for)’
ἐρινύες: Ἐρινύς — Erinys, Fury (avenging spirit); fem. nom. pl.
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’)
ἐσσι: εἰμί — be; pres. 2 sg., epic (= Attic εἶ)
ἑκάστῳ: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. dat. sg.
ἑλὼν: αἱρέω — take, seize, grasp; aor. act. part. masc. nom. sg. (ἑλών): ’having seized’
ἑξείης: ἑξείης — in order, one after another; adv. (Attic ἑξῆς)
ἑτάροισι: ἕταρος — companion (by-form of ἑταῖρος); dat. pl., epic -οισι
ἑταίρους: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. acc. pl.
ἔειπε: εἶπον — say, speak, tell; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted, augment ἐ- kept before the root’s own ει- (= Attic εἶπε)
ἔειπεν: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. 3 sg., epic augmented (ἔ-ειπεν, = Attic εἶπεν)
ἔκτεινον: κτείνω — kill; impf. 3 pl., augmented: ’they were killing’
ἔλθοι: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. opt. 3 sg. ἔμ: ἐγώ — I; encl. acc. sg., elided (ἔμ’ = ἐμέ): ’me’
ἔμελλεν: μέλλω — be about to, be destined to; impf. 3 sg., augmented (root μελλ-, consonant-initial; unaugmented μέλλε(ν)): ’was going to, was destined’
ἔμμεναι: εἰμί — be; pres. inf., epic (= Attic εἶναι)
ἔμπεδον: ἔμπεδος — steady, firm, unbroken; adj., neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’steadily, without a break’
ἔναιον: ναίω — dwell, inhabit; impf. 3 pl.: ‘they dwelt’
ἔνθ: ἔνθα (elided ἔνθ’) — there, then; adverb of place or time
ἔνθεν: ἔνθεν — from there, thence; adv. of place, with suffix -θεν · also ’on the one side’ (ἔνθεν μὲν γὰρ πέτραι ’on one side are rocks’)
ἔοικας: ἔοικα — be like, resemble (+ dat.); perf. 2 sg. with pres. sense: ’you are like’
ἔοικε: ἔοικα — be fitting, seem; perf. with pres. sense, impersonal 3 sg.: ’it is fitting’ · also personal, ’is like, resembles’ + dat. (θεοῖσιν ἔοικε ’he is like the gods’)
ἔπεα: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔπη)
ἔρυσθαι: ἔρυμαι — guard, protect, shelter; epic inf.
ἔστη: ἵστημι — set, stand; aor. 3 sg. intrans.: ’stood, took his stand’
ἔτλη: τλάω — bring oneself to, dare, endure; aor. 3 sg. (ἔτλην, inf. τλῆναι)

ἔφαθ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid. (ἔφατο, elided ἔφαθ’, τ>θ before rough breathing)
ἔφαν: φημί — say; impf./aor. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ἔφασαν): ’they said’
ἔφατ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented, elided (ἔφατ’ = ἔφατο)
ἕκηλος: ἕκηλος — at ease, undisturbed; masc. nom. sg.
ἠέ: ἠέ — or; disjunctive conj. (epic = ἤ), esp. in ἠέ ... ἦ ’either... or’
ἠΰτε: ἠΰτε — like as, even as; epic particle introducing a comparison
ἠοῖ: ἠώς — dawn; fem. dat. sg. ἠοῖ
ἠῶ: ἠώς (Attic ἕως) — dawn; acc. sg., accusative of extent: ’on into the dawn’ · also acc. after πρός: ’towards the dawn, the east’ (πρὸς ἠῶ) · also direct object of a verb of waiting: ’(waited for) Dawn’ (ἐμείναμεν Ἠῶ δῖαν)
ἡ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. nom. sg.: ’she’ · also fem. nom. sg. ’it’, of a pool of water (ἡ δὲ προσέπλαζε ’and it lapped up’) · also fem. nom. sg. ’it’, of a ship (ἡ δ’ ἔθει ’and it ran’) · also fem. nom. sg. with a noun/adj., article-like: ’the other’ (ἡ δ’ ἄλλη ’and the other woman’) · also fem. nom. sg. article-like with a noun: ’the’ (ἡ γὰρ δμώων δίκη ’for the way of servants’)
ἡμέων: ἐγώ (pl. ἡμεῖς) — I, we; gen. pl. ’of us’, epic uncontracted (= Attic ἡμῶν)

ἤθελε: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing, want; impf. 3 sg.

ἦλθον: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. 3 pl.: ’they came’ · also aor. 1 sg. (the same ending serves both persons): ’I have come’

ἰὼν: εἶμι — go; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’going’
ἵκετ: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at, reach; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented and elided (ἵκετ’ = ἵκετο) · also augmented, with the long ι that the metre needs (ἵκετ’ ἐμὸν δῶ ’came to my house’)
ἵκηαι: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive, reach; aor. subj. 2 sg. mid.: ’you may reach’
ἵκοιτο: ἱκνέομαι — come to, arrive at, reach; aor. opt. 3 sg. mid., wish/potential: ’might come, may he reach’
ἶφι: ἶφι — mightily, by force; adv. (instrumental -φι of ἴς)
ὀΐω: ὀΐομαι — think, suppose; pres. 1 sg. (act. form ὀΐω, epic; = Attic οἴομαι): ’I think’
ὀδυσσεύς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus, the poem’s hero; nom. sg.
ὀδυσσεὺς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus, the poem’s hero; nom. sg.
ὀνείδεα: ὄνειδος — reproach, taunt, blame; neut. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὀνείδη)
ὀξέϊ: ὀξύς — sharp, keen; masc. dat. sg., epic ὀξέϊ (= Attic ὀξεῖ)
ὀπτῆρας: ὀπτήρ — watcher, scout; masc. acc. pl.

ὁδόν: ὁδός — road, way, journey; fem. acc. sg.
ὁππότ: ὁππότε (elided ὁππότ’) — whenever, when; epic (= Attic ὁπότε)
ὃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also plain demonstrative, ’he’ (ὃς γὰρ δεύτατος ἦλθεν), not a relative
ὄλβιος: ὄλβιος — blessed, fortunate, prosperous; masc. nom. sg.
ὄφρ: ὄφρα (elided ὄφρ’) — so that, in order that; epic (= Attic ἵνα); + subj. · also temporal, ’as long as, while’ + indicative (ὄφρ’ ἔτι κεῖνος ἀνὴρ ἐπιδήμιος ἦεν ’as long as that man was still at home’) · also ’while’ + ἄν and subj. · also temporal ’until’ + indicative (ὄφρ’ ἵκετ’ Ἀρήτην ’until he came to Arete’) · also ’until’ + ἄν and subj. ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also with τις, an indirect interrogative: οὐκ οἶδ’ ὅς τις ’I know not who’ · also with τις, indefinite relative: ὅς τις … φάγοι ’whoever should eat’

ὑπερηνορεόντων: ὑπερηνορέω — play the overbearing man, be overweening (ὑπέρ + ἀνήρ); pres. part. gen. pl., epic uncontracted, partitive with τις
ὑπόδρα: ὑπόδρα — with a scowl, ’from under the brows’ (ancient explanation; derivation uncertain); adv.
ὑφορβόν: ὑφορβός — swineherd (ὑπό + φέρβω ’feed’); masc. acc. sg.
ὕβρει: ὕβρις — wanton violence, arrogance; fem. dat. sg., with εἴξαντες: ’to (their) arrogance’
ὕβριν: ὕβρις — insolence, wanton violence; fem. acc. sg.

ἂν … ἔρχησθον ’so that you two may go’)
ὢ: ὤ — oh! ah! (exclamation, as in ὢ πόποι)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως) · also postpositive after its noun (anastrophe), = comparative ὡς ’as, like’: ὄρνις δ’ ὥς ’like a bird’
ὤτρυνα: ὀτρύνω — urge on, rouse; aor. 1 sg., augmented: ’I urged’ (+ inf.)
ὥς: ὥς — thus, so; also (with κε/ἄν + subj.) ’so that, in order that’; adverb/conjunction · also introducing an indirect question: ’how’ (ὥς κε νέηται ’how he is to return’, after φράσσεται) · or ὡς ’as’, accented before enclitic τε · also causal, ’since, seeing that’ (ὥς οἱ ἐναργὲς ὄνειρον ἐπέσσυτο ’since a vivid dream had come upon her’) · also with κεν + opt., purpose: ’so that’ (ὥς κεν … γένοιτο ’so that he might become’) · also ὥς ’just as’, in ὥς περ (accented before enclitic περ) (ὥς περ ὑπέστης ’just as you promised’) · also ὡς ’as’, accented before enclitic με (ὥς με κελεύεις ’as you bid me’) · also postpositive after its noun, comparative ’like’ (οἰωνῶν ὥς ’like birds’) · also ὡς ’as’, accented before enclitic τοι (ὥς τοι ἐγὼν ἐρέω ’as I shall tell you’) · also correlative ’so’ answering ὅπως, introducing a wish with the opt., accented before the enclitic τοι: ’so may’ (ὥς τοι Ζεὺς τελέσειεν ’so may Zeus fulfil it for you’) · also with a plain subj. (no κε/ἄν), purpose: ’so that’ (ὥς τοι δῶρ’ ἀποπέμψω ’so that I may send you the gifts’)
ὧδε: ὧδε — here, to this place, in this way; adv.
ᾧ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc. dat. sg.: ’his own (son)’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which; masc. dat. sg. (δοίη δ’ ᾧ κ’ ἐθέλοι ’give her to whom he wished’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν, neut. dat. sg. (same form), agreeing with a neut. noun: πεδίοιο ... ᾧ ἔνι ... ’a plain in which is...’ · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν, neut. dat. sg., agreeing with ἄχεϊ: ’her own (grief)’
ῥ: ἄρα (weakened ῥα, elided ῥ’) — then, indeed, so; inferential particle
